clips.title: The story
paras: Shoni the Shilent sends Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines for a power core. The displaced gnomes need it to power drills that can break through the rock around Gnomeregan and help reclaim their home.

After Gnomeregan fell catastrophically to primitive troggs, surviving gnomish tinkerers fled across Khaz Modan and Stormwind. Shoni the Shilent is among the engineers already planning how to breach the rock around their lost home. Her gyrodrillmatic excavationators need great power to bore through the underground stone. Without local power grids in human lands, the gnomes have turned to goblin heavy machinery in the criminal underworld.

Deep in the twisting shafts of the Deadmines in Westfall, Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood employs goblin engineers to build war machines. One is a working goblin shredder, a lumbering automaton. Shoni sends Alliance operatives to destroy or dismantle it and recover its specialized heart, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket. The exiled gnomes need the goblin power supply to drive their drills through the underground rock and begin their counteroffensive to reclaim Gnomeregan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, friend.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
